local_review.finding_body: The CXFAuthenticator scenario exercised reflection over private java.net.Authenticator fields and methods, but CXF catches Throwable and discards the failure, so Native Image refusal cannot be verified and the test's null assertion stayed green without proving the reflected behavior. The accompanying java.net --add-opens JVM and native build flags were introduced for a stronger delegation scenario that had already been removed, so they no longer met the uniform-necessity rule in FS-test-contract.2.7.
local_review.finding_title: Unverifiable CXFAuthenticator scenario relied on unnecessary module-opening flags
local_review.fix_note: Dropped only the unverifiable CXFAuthenticator scenario and removed its java.net --add-opens flags. The unsupported mechanism is reflection into substituted JDK Authenticator internals, CXF erases the error so the sanctioned helper cannot prove refusal, and the remaining suite still exercises CXF's public HTTP, HTTPS, and servlet APIs. Forge regenerated stats to 20/25 (80%) dynamic-access coverage, and a second complete finalization pass was stable and successful.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff for allowed paths and metadata format; checked the non-scaffold, version-agnostic tests, separate test package, Native Image behavior, build flags, index evidence, and reported coverage. After repair, dynamic-access coverage is 20/25 (80%), the entry-count mismatch guard does not trigger, and the exact Forge finalizer passed all three native lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test validity, and statistics without further publishable changes.
